description: Open the official Codex interface and show account quotas.
notifications: Show status notifications for completed, failed, or waiting Codex tasks.
windowsNotifications: Show Windows toast notifications while VS Code is in the background.
notificationSound: Play a sound when a Codex task finishes or needs your answer.
cliPath: Path to the Codex CLI executable. Empty uses the official extension's bundled CLI, then PATH.
